title: Pick Me Up
blurb: 1-Star heroes are just fodder for learning a boss' attack patterns. That was Seojin Han's philosophy when playing the notoriously difficult game Pick Me Up. But after being transported into the game as one of those 1-star heroes, he's got no choice but to rise in rank and defeat the player controlling him and his party. Can a gacha game character hope to defeat a player akin to being his god?

title: Absolute Regression
blurb: The past has changed, but like a fiery comet, he still comes. Mugi Hwa, the one without equal, slashed through Murim's skies with his sword, toppling every lord who dared to face him–even Cheonma, Mugeuk Geom’s father. But Mugeuk didn’t accept defeat. Instead, he turned to the forbidden: a time-bending ritual that hurled him into his own past. Now, retracing his steps, he races against the clock until Mugi emerges once again. But this time, it's not just about power, but mending old wounds and forging new bonds to unite his people and prepare for the bloodtide to come.

title: Murim Psychopath
blurb: The predator of predators has awakened! In life, Bongsu was a serial killer who exclusively hunted murderers and violent criminals. After being gunned down by the police, his dying wish comes true: rebirth inside his favorite game, the brutally graphic world of Murim Online. Armed with a status window only he can see, Bongsu discovers that every kill earns him experience points—and the stronger the prey, the greater the reward. In a world overflowing with ruthless, corrupt martial artists, Bongsu has found the perfect hunting ground. His bloody journey toward the top begins.

title: Return of the Blossoming Blade
blurb: When Cheong-Myeong of the Mount Hua Sect awakens a hundred years in the future, his last memories are of a bloody battle against the Leader of the Demonic Cult, the evil Cheon-Ma. The battle almost saw the end of the Ten Great Sects of ancient China, when Cheong-Myeong ended the hard-fought struggle by striking down Cheon-Ma. Soon after, he succumbed to his wounds, filled with regret at their pyrrhic victory. All is not lost, however, as he awakens to his second chance at life. Shocked to find his beloved Mount Hua Sect reduced to a mere shadow of itself in the present day, Cheong-Myeong embarks on a journey to restore Mount Hua to its former glory.

title: Descended from Divinity
blurb:
“Is this a mission I was sent on by the gods? Or is this just divine punishment?”
Jung-Hyeok Baek, divine demon overlord of Murim, finds that he’s been reincarnated into the body of Roman Dimitri, the dim-witted son of a baron who’s obsessed with the luxuries of the aristocratic lifestyle. But with his new status, Jung-Hyeok is ready to shake things up on the continent of Salamander. Will the divine demon accomplish what he’s set out to do? And will he finally get the answers to this mysterious reincarnation?

title: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok
blurb: In a world of gates, monsters, and hunters galore, Soo-Ho Sung is…well, he’s just an ordinary college student. Sure, his parents went missing right before the gates started appearing three years ago, and he occasionally had a weird dream where he could beat up monsters and level up like a video game, but other than that? There’s absolutely nothing special about him. So when a sudden monster outbreak occurs on his campus, he must fight back every instinct screaming at him to run away as he takes a page out of his dad’s book and rushes to save his classmate. The chances of making it alive are looking bleak, until—PING! [Congratulations on becoming a Player.]

title: Overgeared
blurb: Sin Yeong-U (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game “Satisfy,” finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: “Pagma’s Successor.” He’s now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game’s most powerful gear. Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for….

title: Chronicles of a Doomed Prodigy
blurb: Gifted by the heavens yet cursed by fate, Yeonshin was born with unimaginable talent in martial arts. But this very gift condemned him to a life that would end before adulthood. With the right opportunities, he had the potential to become a legendary hero, or the reincarnation of the Heavenly Demon. Yet fate cast him into the third-rate Jeong Clan, a family of no particular renown. Now, with time slipping through his fingers, Yeonshin must find a way to defy his doomed destiny.

title: Absolute Sword Sense
blurb: For as long as he can remember, Woonhwi So has been the black sheep of his family and clan. Because his spirit core has been destroyed, he has no choice but to serve as a third-rate spy for the Blood Cult. One day, during his mission to find the legendary Blade Scroll, he is killed and sent 10 years into the past. When Woonhwi regains consciousness, he realizes that he has been sent back to the day he was kidnapped by the Blood Cult, and that he has gained a mysterious ability to hear the voice of a dagger.

title: There's No Such Thing as a Bad Lady
blurb: Raised in the slums of Ebelstein, Derek knows all too well that magic cannot bridge social divides. Through harsh lessons and hard-earned discipline, he rises to become a second-tier mage, scraping by as a mercenary. Life takes a different turn when he is appointed as a magical tutor to Diella Duplain-- the temperamental youngest daughter of a noble house, unable to wield magic despite her lineage. Though Derek is her last resort before exile to a convent, Diella clashes with him from the start. Together, will they be able to prove that there’s no such thing as a “bad” lady?

title: Madoseoreul Jupda Mabeopsaga Doeda
blurb: A single grimoire found in an old bookshop changed his life forever. A college student forms a contract with an invisible vampire that tears people apart and kills them. Hiding his true identity, he must grow into a mage in this modern occult coming-of-age fantasy.

title: The World After the Fall
blurb: Faced with imminent defeat and certain death, would you choose to run – or continue to fight for a doomed world? When mysterious towers appear across the world, summoning monsters that prey on mankind, this is the choice presented to the Tower Walkers – adventurers with special powers to fight the monsters. On the brink of death, they can choose to use a “regression stone” to return to the past for a second chance, though this decision places them in a separate timeline forever. Stubborn Tower Walker Jae-Hwan rejects this choice, choosing to fight for the original timeline, and learning shocking secrets about the Tower along the way.

title: My Very Own Tower Strategy Guide
blurb: 15 days until the apocalypse happens. That's what Ho-Yeong Lee, a 29-year-old office worker, learns when he takes the mysterious medicine he got for saving a goblin from a bear trap. As it turns out, it allows him to level up more easily and provides him with a strategy guide! Everyone in the world is forced into groups to conquer the mysterious Apocalypse Tower, and Ho-Yeong has to find a way to work with his teammates so that everyone makes it to the top alive. Will his ability give him an advantage, or will it end up spelling out his doom?

title: Cheonhwa Archive's Young Master
blurb: Once hailed as the Murim Alliance leader, Hoo Gong suddenly awakens in the body of Beom Hang, the disgrace of the Cheonhwa Family. Broken in mind and body, Beom Hang had no future... But things are different now. With the power from his discarded life, he will teach the martial world that true strength never dies.

title: Eleceed
blurb: Ji-U is a kind-hearted young man who harnesses the lightning quick reflexes of a cat to secretly make the world a better place – one saved little child or foster pet at a time. Kayden is a secret agent on the run, who finds himself stuck in the body of a…um…decidedly fat old fluffy cat. Together, armed with Ji-U’s super powers and Kayden’s uber-smarts, they’re out to fight those forces who would let evil rule this world. That is, if they can stand each other long enough to get the job done.

title: The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero
blurb: Humans call them “calamities”—the unknown, destructive creatures that suddenly appeared on earth. To challenge these calamities, the zodiac gods awakened 12 humans known as saints. But there was one more that awoke—unchosen but the greatest hero of all: Geon Lee. His allies betrayed him and left him for dead, but now, 20 years later, he’s more powerful than ever and ready to teach his fellow “saints” a lesson they’ll never forget.

title: Reincarnation of the Fist King
blurb: Wuseong Dan, the man who ruled over the martial world with his fists alone. After unexpectedly losing a duel against two practitioners of the Demonic Way, he’s reborn into the body of the wild child heir apparent of the affluent Silver River Merchants. Not one to leave debts unpaid, be they to his benefit or detriment, Wuseong sets out on his path of revenge in the body of Jineon Lee. Using his knowledge of martial arts from his past life and the wealth of his current life, he only has one goal: get stronger and kill those who killed him.

title: Too Many Heroes for the Demon Lord
blurb: Berje Deias was once a by-the-book Demon King, but after being reborn, he is determined to break every rule there is. His second attempt at life, however, takes a chaotic turn when a kidnapping of a princess doesn’t quite go to plan! Can he defeat an entire continent of heroes with his wild, untested methods?!

title: I Married the Dragon I Killed
blurb: Cast out by his family for refusing a betrothal to the dreaded Red Dragon Valdrova, Ferda Rosnova chooses a path of blood and vengeance. After claiming Valdrova’s heart—a heart she surrendered without resistance—Ferda ascends to godlike status. However, a glimpse into the depth of the dragon’s ancient despair renders his triumph hollow and reveals the utter emptiness of his ambition. Armed with his new power, Ferda turns back time to start over. This time, he won't run; he decides to embrace his fate and marry the dragon who willingly gave him her heart.

title: The Infinite Mage
blurb: After Sirone was abandoned in a stable, he was found by a family of hunters and raised in a loving home. Despite the hardships of the peasant life, he learned how to read from a young age and became obsessed with books, especially ones on the history of magic. One day, he has an unlikely encounter with a mage and learns how to enter the "spirit zone," the first step to learning how to use magic. Although they say only nobles can be mages, will Sirone be able to prove his infinite potential?

title: Nano Machine
blurb: Nanotechnology meets martial arts at the Mashin Academy. Yeo-Un’s mother may not be one of the High Priest’s six official wives, but his father’s blood still qualifies him for a chance at the position of Minor Priest. Will a mysterious nanomachine injection from a future descendent help Yeo-un in this fierce competition against his powerful half-siblings?

title: The Reborn Young Lord is an Assassin
blurb: Cyan Vert, illegitimate son of the Duke and the empire's greatest assassin, is betrayed by the righteous brother whose shadow he's always lived in. But just before the fatal blow strikes his throat, Cyan awakes to find he's just a boy again. The young lord has been reborn, and this time, he's not going to live in anyone's shadow!

title: Darling, Why Can't We Divorce?
blurb: After waking up in the middle of the woods, on a rainy night, and in the body of a novel's villainess, Ophelia Lizen just wants one thing... a divorce! But she is married to Duke Sylvester Lizen, who genuinely seems fond of her and lets her do anything her heart desires — even if that's stalking the crown prince. Wanting to shed her wicked ways, Ophelia tries to turn over a new leaf, but how can she when Sylvester's one divorce condition is for her to seduce the crown prince who despises her?

title: Dragonnap
blurb: Yu Jitae is a Regressor wielding limitless power—and he still isn't strong enough to prevent the end of the world. Because four bored, young dragons once descended to Earth for fun, Yu has been caught in an endless cycle of failing to stop the apocalypse. But this time, in yet another timeline, Yu decides to try something different: maybe he can nurture the destruction out of these dragons as their guardian!

title: Reincarnated Murim Lord
blurb: Regret is the bane of old men. When aging Alliance Lord Hajin Cheon of the Grand Martial Alliance reflects on his immense legacy, he finds that he recalls little of his deeds or even the lives of his closest advisors. Stricken by a mysterious ailment, Hajin suddenly passes away only to wake up in the body of Ridan Byeok, heir to the Byeok Clan of swordsmen. The only problem is, Ridan is a well-known wastrel, the polar opposite of the virtuous and stern Hajin. Righting the wrongs of his predecessor, Hajin begins to uncover the truth behind his death…

title: Infinite Leveling: Murim
blurb: Killed on the battlefield without glory to his name, Yuseong Dan receives an opportunity to grow stronger with a strange quest and level system. But each quest he’s forced to fight only seems to be getting harder and harder. Can he level up enough to avoid the same miserable ending and become the powerful hero he wishes to be?

title: The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan
blurb: Cecil Perdium, the Mercenary King, was killed in battle before he could avenge his family. As he faces death, he learns that Duke Delphine, the man who caused the downfall of his family, didn't work alone. Suddenly waking up as his teenage self, Cecil must work to both overcome his poor reputation and build up his strength to save his family. With their soldiers and knights defecting due to the harsh conditions they must endure, he has his work cut out for him. Can Cecil become the mighty warrior he once was and avert his family's fate?

title: How to Use a Returner
blurb: [Will you join the game?] Giyoung's suddenly thrown into a game of life and death. Not only that but he's also the player with the lowest stats. Still, he's got one skill on his side: the ability to read other players' status! He finds the opportunity of his life when he discovers that Hyunsung is a returner to this world. Now all Giyoung has to do is stick next to Hyunsung and game his way out of this tutorial.

title: The Swordmaster's Son
blurb: Jin Runcandel was destined to become the head of his swordmaster clan. But despite his best efforts, he's banished for his shoddy swordsmanship. Though Jin eventually makes a contract with the god Solderet and is freed from the curse that hindered his abilities, he meets a rather unfortunate end. In the next moment, however, he awakens as a baby, long before his tragedy began. Armed with a second chance and some new powers, Jin swears to fulfill his destiny and become the ultimate swordmaster.

title: Lout of Count’s Family
blurb: Kim Rok-Su has one life motto: “Let’s not get beat up.” But after dozing off somewhere midway through the novel “Birth of a Hero,” he wakes up as Cale Henituse - one of the minor villains in the novel who gets the beating of a lifetime from soon-to-be hero Choi Han. Only time will tell how much longer he has before that dreadful encounter. Can Kim Rok-Su change the course of this story so he can enjoy a long and lavish life free of the soon-to-be hero?

title: After Ten Millennia in Hell
blurb: Oh Kangwoo the Demon King has had it with ruling over Hell and wants to return to Earth. But when he finally gets there, not only are his powers sealed, but the Earth he once knew has turned into an MMORPG free-for-all. Dimensional gates have appeared all over the world, and "players" enter them to make a living by hunting monsters. If Kangwoo wants to survive in this dangerous game, he's going to have to level up, and fast. But for this demon king, hell on earth might be worse than Hell itself!

title: Monster-ui Inbang Star
blurb:
Born in a dark, damp cave, Squishy is a low-level slime with an ordinary fate ahead of him: to live and die as an insignificant monster. However, from the moment of his birth, Squishy was chosen by both magic and the system, awakening as an unusually intelligent slime alongside a livestream... And the world he encounters for the first time is far vaster and more wondrous than he ever imagined.
“I want to see it!”
Watching over Squishy are his dependable (?) viewers—Queen Squish, an overprotective Slime Queen, Cheeky Smartie, a lich who loves to tease but always makes sure to share useful knowledge, and even Arachne and Fenrir, who are so smitten with the adorable Squishy that they appoint themselves as his masters. As he travels the world in his tiny body, fighting, eating, and evolving, Squishy soon finds himself facing new adventures beyond anything he could have imagined. Here begins an adorable, harmless slime's chaotic journey of survival and exploration! Will Squishy survive unscathed and get to see the vast, wonderful world he's always dreamed of?

title: Chowolmuje
blurb: In a murim where war has become a thing of the past, even peace comes at a price. In an age where the fate of entire martial sects is decided through duels, prestigious clans secretly trade in human weapons known as “Amhyung”—individuals trained to master and counter the martial arts of rival sects. Raised for a single purpose—to ensure victory—they are mercilessly discarded and erased from existence once their usefulness has ended. But those who were cast aside have not forgotten. Now, the forsaken rise to exact their revenge.

title: The Extra’s Academy Survival Guide
blurb: Ed Rothstaylor is a third-rate villain in a game, disowned by his family and kicked out of the dormitory for his misdeeds. One day, our main character wakes up as this very Ed, and realizes he must earn a scholarship so he can graduate and be set for life. Now living in the woods, he resolves to keep away from the protagonists, but four of the female leads just won't leave him alone. Not only that, his presence starts to change the timeline and events of the game! Can Ed help the story progress while staying out of the limelight?

title: Forced to Be the Heavenly Demon
blurb: Ji-Hun Seo is a civil servant who wants nothing more than a peaceful, easy life. But after an angry complainant stabs him, he wakes up in the Murim, a world ruled by martial arts. Reborn as Ilmok, he quickly settles into a quiet job at a local inn, only for the Heavenly Demon to appear and force him to become his disciple. Now surrounded by deadly martial artists and even deadlier training, can Ilmok survive the Demonic Cult without sacrificing the one thing he values most: a healthy work-life balance?

title: The Otherworldly Nutritionist
blurb: Dominic, a war refugee who once lived as a nutritionist in a past life, settles in the small fishing village of Evergreen hoping for a quiet start. Instead, he is abruptly named village headman after the former leader steps down for the absurd reason that he refuses to learn how to read. Dominic’s nutritional and medical knowledge earns him unexpected attention when he diagnoses the former lord’s chronic foot pain through diet alone. His growing reputation soon draws the attention of the entire lord’s castle, changing his peaceful life forever.

title: Best Teacher Baek
blurb: Once the finest instructor in the Blood Cult, Suryong Baek is killed, only to wake up in the body of someone who teaches martial arts at a small rural academy. His new body may be weak, but he knows how to fix it, and it’s not the first time that he’s found himself in a body that can’t access its inner power. Curing his body requires money, however, and Suryong decides that becoming the greatest instructor at a top academy is the best way to do it. Since he’ll be up against tough competition, Suryong will have to use everything he’s got to become a teaching superstar.

title: Revenge of the Baskerville Bloodhound
blurb: Raised to kill like a pack of loyal hounds, the Baskerville children took countless lives as a band of fearsome assassins. Despite being the shunned illegitimate son of the brood, Vikir served his family faithfully, only to meet his untimely demise at his father’s hands. But when he is inexplicably reborn with a second chance at life, Vikir, armed with the memories and knowledge of his past, swears to rise above the pack and take his revenge. This time, he's ready to bite the hand that feeds.

title: Chronicles of the Demon Faction
blurb: Tired of the yoke of the Divine Justice Alliance, master assassin Cheon Ha-Jin attempts to flee, only to be confronted by martial artists of all allegiances, both orthodox and deviant. Succumbing to the wounds of his ferocious struggle for freedom, he awakens in the body of Seo Ryang, a prince of the notorious Heavenly Demon Cult who suffers from a disorder that prohibits him from the use of qi. In order to survive in his new life, Ha-Jin must contend with the many dangers and enemies that lurk within the cult.

title: The Genius Murim Fitness Trainer
blurb: Ganghyeok is ruined. His gym business is failing and there's no way he can pay off his debts. But one night, while reading his favorite author's latest webnovel, he gets sucked into a world of martial arts fantasy and wakes up as a child monk in the Shaolin temple. There, he must apply his knowledge of modern fitness to survive their strict training, juggle the friends and enemies he makes along the way, and find a way to get back home.

title: Euntoe Seongnyeoga Jipgap Ollyeodeurimnida
blurb: The male lead, who had been repeatedly reincarnating, went mad and turned the entire empire into a sea of flames. I ended up possessing the body of a character in the web novel If You Pick Up a Sword, You Might as Well Slit Someone's Throat...And of all things, I became one of the countless saintesses. My goal is singular...

title: Academy-ui Mugibokjeja
blurb:
A game no one has ever managed to conquer: Etius.
[GAME OVER]
The moment every possible strategy had failed…
“Student Frondier?”
I became Frondier, a mere extra in the game! Stores and replicates the image of an object. However, the replica is merely an illusion. All I have is the ability to replicate objects as illusions!
[Main Quest: Change of Fate]
You know the fate that awaits humanity... the day it will meet its end. Save humanity and change its destiny.
“I’m supposed to change fate with this?!”
Replicate everything. Forge a new destiny!

title: Sinip Gongmuwoneun Villain Japgo Toegeunhamnida
blurb:
If they won’t let me leave for the day, I’ll just quit. If they won’t let me quit, I’ll just get rid of the company.
“I explicitly asked for the terms of my employment contract to be honored.”
Remember just one thing: the only good villain is a dead one.

title: Log-in Murim
blurb: When an interdimensional portal appeared and released countless monsters across the world, humanity didn’t take the threat lying down. Mankind fought back, defeating the monsters' Demon King and creating a new way of life as "hunters." But when Taekyung Jin, a struggling, low-ranked hunter, accidentally logs into a game on a beat-up VR console, he finds himself trapped in an all-new world, unable to log out.

title: I’m the Max-Level Newbie
blurb: Kang Jin-Hyeok, a gaming streamer, and content creator is the only person who has cleared the game, [Tower of Trials]. However, as the game’s popularity declines, it becomes increasingly difficult for him to continue making a living as a content creator. Jinhyeok prepares to end his 11-year-long relationship with the game and say goodbye to his humble group of subscribers. But on that very day, the Tower of Trials appears in reality with a message saying that humanity will perish unless all players clear each floor within 90 days. Jin-Hyeok, who knows the game better than anyone, decides to use his knowledge to his advantage and dominate the tower. It’s time to show everyone what a hardcore gamer can do!

title: Myst, Might, Mayhem
blurb: All Jeong wants is a second chance – for revenge! His grandfather’s gruesome death has transformed him into the bloodthirsty and ruthless Scythe Demon. He will stop at nothing until he has killed the man responsible. Yet rage and determination alone are not enough. He must train in martial arts if he ever wants to stand a chance against such a formidable foe. Will he succeed in his revenge on the murderer of his grandfather?

title: Blink Master of the Magic Academy
blurb: In the game Aether World, Baek Yuseol is considered the most useless character because he can't use magic like everyone else. His only skill, Blink, is a short-range teleportation ability most players consider worthless. But when he’s tasked with reaching the game's true ending, Baek Yuseol decides to use his unconventional skill to achieve this impossible goal. Can this so-called "trash" character outsmart his powerful peers, form unlikely alliances, and ultimately master the game?

title: Shadow of the Supreme
blurb: Yang-Cheon Ku, born to the virtuous House of Ku of Sanseo, the Little Star and next Head of House. Status: The world’s most hated demonic martial artist. Cause of death: Defeated during the Virtuous-Demonic War, tortured upon capture. Or so he thought. Moments after dying in the arms of his childhood friend, the Heavenly Sword herself, Seol-ah Wi, he finds himself back in the past. Already things have changed, but is it enough to ensure his second chance at life doesn’t end with the same regrets?

title: The White Tower’s Rogue Mage
blurb: Once the greatest mage and Grand Magus of the White Tower, Oscar Sage dies in a war against The Demon Emperor—only to awaken twenty years later as the disgraced noble, Oscar Crusian. The once-mighty White Tower lies in ruins, and rival factions hold control over military and resources. With his mana circuits sealed and former allies now enemies, Oscar must rebuild the White Tower, seek vengeance, and reclaim his power before the Mage Council exiles him for good. Will magic rise again or will it be buried forever?

title: The Sword-Eating Swordmaster
blurb: Only a swordmaster can slay another. Arhan believed the tales of Liam Karavan, the founding father of his house, were nothing more than legend, until a deadly swordmaster slaughtered everyone dear to him. In his darkest hour, Liam comes to him as a guiding spirit, revealing the true power of their bloodline--the power to devour blades and inherit the strength and memories held within. With each sword consumed, Arhan draws one step closer to vengeance. To avenge his loved ones and restore House Karavan to its former glory, he must survive the perilous path to becoming a swordmaster.
